items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) Zero-Day
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code by injecting malicious code into the template system, primarily via 'Payment Transaction Failed Reminder' emails. It has been actively exploited in the wild to deploy backdoors and web shells.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update addresses a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could lead to arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this vulnerability being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including those that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. It is recommended to apply the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to this update.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento allows an attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction or prior authentication. It has been observed being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: This stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows low-privileged authenticated attackers to inject malicious JavaScript into form fields. Successful exploitation can lead to session hijacking or unauthorized actions within the victim's account context.
